G2600.def:
κατα-βαρύνω
[in LXX: 2Rs 13:25 14:26 (כָּבַד), Jl 2:8, Sir.8:15 * ;]
= καταβαρέω: pass., Pres. ptcp., Mc 14:40.†
(AS)

G2602.def:
κατα-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταβάλλω), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:29 * ;]
__1. a laying down: εἰς κ. σπέρματος, Hb 11:11 (EV, to conceive seed).
__2. a foundation (of a house, ii Mac, l.with): metaphorically, ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, Mt 13:35 (LXX) (om. ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, WH, R, mg.), Mt 25:34, Lc 11:50, Hb 4:3 9:26, Ap 13:8 17:8; πρὸ κ. κόσμου, Jo 17:24, Ef 1:4, 1Pe 1:20.†
(AS)

G2603.def:
κατα-βραβεύω
(βραβεύς, an umpire, cf βραβεῖον)
to give judg­ment against, condemn (see Field, Notes, 196; Abbott, Essays, 104 f.): Cl 2:18.†
(AS)

G2604.def:
καταγγελεύς, -έως, ὁ
a proclaimer, herald (in Inscr., κ. ἀγώνων, Deiss., LAE, 97): with genitive obj., At 17:18.†
(AS)

G2605.def:
κατ-αγγέλλω
[in LXX: Pv 17:5 A, 2Ma.8:36 2Mac 9:17 * ;]
__1. to pro­claim, declare: with accusative of thing(s), At 3:24 16:21 17:23; τ. ἀνάστασιν, At 4:2; τ. λόγον τοῦ Θ., τ. Κ., At 13:5 15:36; ὁδὸν σωτηρίας, At 16:17; φῶς, At 26:23; τ. μυστήριον τοῦ Θ., 1Co 2:1; τ. εὐαγγέλιον, 1Co 9:14; τ. θάνατον τοῦ Κ., 1Co 11:26; pass., ἄφεσις, At 13:33; ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θ., At 17:13; ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν, Rm 1:8; with accusative of person(s), of Christ, ὅν, At 17:3, Cl 1:28; τ. Χριστόν, Fp 1:17; pass., Fp 1:18.
__2. to denounce (Xen., al.); (for comparison with ἀγγέλλω, ἀναγ-, ἀπαγ-, see Westc. on 1Jo 1:5; and cf. προ-καταγγέλλω).†
(AS)

G2606.def:
κατα-γελάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂחַק, Jó 5:22, Pv 29:9, al. ;]
to deride, laugh scornfully at: with genitive of person(s), Mt 9:24, Mc 5:40, Lc 8:53.†
(AS)

G2607.def:
κατα-γινώσκω
(see: γινώσκω), [in LXX: Dt 25:1 (רָשַׁע hi.), Pv 28:11 (חָקַר), Sir.14:2 19:5 * ;]
to blame, condemn: with genitive of person(s), 1Jo 3:20-21; pass., κατεγνωσμένος ἦν (RV, he stood condemned, see Ellie., in l; but cf. Field, Notes, 188): Gl 2:11.†
(AS)

G2608.def:
κατ-άγνυμι
[in LXX for נָחַת pi., etc. ;]
to break: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 12:20 (LXX), Jo 19:31-33.†
(AS)

G2609.def:
κατ-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for יָרַד hi. ;]
to bring down: with accusative of person(s), At 22:30, Rm 10:6; id. before εἰς, At 9:30 23:15, 20 23:28; as nautical term, to bring to land: τ. πλοῖον ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Lc 5:11; pass., before εἰς, At 27:3 2:12.†
(AS)

G2610.def:
κατ-αγωνίζομαι depon., "perfective" compound (M, Pr., 116);
__1. to struggle against.
__2. to conquer, overcome: Hb 11:33.†
(AS)

G2611.def:
κατα-δέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for חָבַשׁ, etc. ;]
to bind up: τ. τραύματα (cf. Sir.27:21), Lc 10:34.†
(AS)

G2613.def:
κατα-δικάζω
[in LXX: Sl 94:21 (רָשַׁע hi.), La 3:36 (עָוַת pi.), Wis.2:20, al. ;]
to pass sentence upon, condemn; in cl., with genitive of person(s) (accusative of thing(s)); in late writers (so LXX), with accusative of person(s) (θανάτῳ, Wis, l.with): Mt 12:7, Tg 5:6; absol. (as Plat., Legg., 958c), Lc 6:37; pass., Mt 12:37, Lc 6:37.†
δικάζω,
to judge: Lc 6:37 (Tr., mg.; see: καταδ-; Cremer, 199).†
(AS)

G2614.def:
κατα-διώκω
[in LXX chiefly for רָדַף ;]
"perfective" compound (M, Pr., 116), to pursue closely, follow up
__(a) with hostile intent (Thuc., i, 49, Gn 31:36 al.);
__(b) with kindly intention (Sl 23:6, 1Rs 30:22, cf. Sir.27:17): Mc 1:36.†
(AS)

G2615.def:
κατα-δουλόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for עָבַד ;]
to enslave: 2Co 11:20, Gl 2:4.†
(AS)

G2616.def:
κατα-δυναστεύω
[in LXX for יָנָה, עָשַׁק, etc. ;]
to exercise power over, oppress: with accusative of person(s) (Xen.; LXX, Mq 2:2, Wis.2:10, al.); with genitive of person(s), Tg 2:6 (ὑμᾶς, T); pass., At 10:38 (cf. MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)

G2617.def:
κατ-αισχύνω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ ;]
to disgrace, dishonour, put to shame: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 11:4-5; with accusative of person(s), 1Co 1:27 11:22; pass., to be ashamed: Lc 13:17, 2Co 7:14 9:4, 1Pe 3:16; as in LXX (Sl 22:6 25:2-3, al.), of unfulfilled hopes: Rm 5:5; pass., Rm 9:33 10:11, 1Pe 2:6" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G2618.def:
κατα-καίω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף; in Êx 3:2 (אָכַל pu.), distinguished from καίω ;]
to burn up, burn completely: with accusative of thing(s), Mt 13:30 At 19:19; pass., 1Co 3:15, Hb 13:11, 2Pe 3:10, Ap 8:7; before πυρί Mt 3:12 13:40, Lc 3:17 (cf. Êx 29:14, al.); ἐν πυρί (Dt 9:21, al.): Ap 17:16 18:8.†
(AS)

G2619.def:
κατα-καλύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi. ;]
to cover up; mid., to cover or veil oneself: 1Co 11:6; τ. κεφαλήν, 1Co 11:7.†
(AS)

G2620.def:
κατα-καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX: Zc 10:12 (הָלַךְ hith.), Jr 50:11 (עָלַז), Jr 50:38 (הָלַל)* ;]
__1. to boast against, exult over: with genitive, Rm 11:18, Tg 2:13; before κατά, with genitive, Tg 3:14 (T, om. κατά).
__2. before ἐν, to glory in (Za., l.with, Jr 27:38).†
(AS)

G2621.def:
κατά-κειμαι
[in LXX: Pv 6:9 23:34 (שָׁכַב), Jdth.13:15, Wis.17:7 * ;]
__1. to lie down.
__2. to lie sick: Mc 1:30 2:4, Jo 5:6, At 28:8; before ἐπί with genitive, At 9:33; id. with accusative, Lc 5:25; ἐν, Jo 5:3.
__3. to recline at meals (cf. ἀνάιειμαι): Mc 14:3, Lc 5:29; before ἐν, Mc 2:15, Lc 7:37, 1Co 8:10.†
(AS)

G2622.def:
κατα-κλάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Eze.19:12 (נָתַשׁ hoph.)* ;]
to break up, break in pieces: Mc 6:41, Lc 9:16.†
(AS)

G2623.def:
κατα-κλείω
[in LXX: Jr 32:3 (כָּלָא), Wis.17:2, 16, 2Ma.13:21, 3Ma.3:25 * ;]
to shut up:. with accusative of person(s), before ἐν φυλακῇ (-αῖς), Lc 3:20, At 26:10.†
(AS)

G2624.def:
κατα-κληρονομέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָחַל, יָרַשׁ, etc. ;]
__1. to distribute by lot or as an inheritance (Nm 34:18, Js 14:1, al.): At 13:19.
__2. to receive by inheritance (Dt 1:38, al.).†
κατα-κληροδοτέω, ῶ,
[in LXX: Dt 1:38 21:16 A (-νομέω, B), (נָחַל), 1Ma.3:36 א R (-νομέω, A)* ;]
At 13:19, Rec., = -νομέω, which see†
(AS)

G2625.def:
κατα-κλίνω
[in LXX: Êx 21:18 (נָפַל), Nm 24:9, Jz 5:27, 1Rs 16:11 (כָּרַע), Jdth.12:15, 3Ma.1:3 * ;]
to lay down, make to lie down, esp. for meals: with accusative of person(s), Lc 9:14-15; mid., to recline at meals: Lc 7:36 24:30; before εἰς, Lc 14:8 (cf. Jth, Lc.).†
(AS)

G2626.def:
κατα-κλύζω
[in LXX for שָׁטַף, Sl 78:20, al. ;]
to inundate, deluge: pass., 2Pe 3:6.†
(AS)

G2627.def:
κατα-κλυσμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κατακλύζω), [in LXX chiefly for מַבּוּל, Gn 6:17, al.; also for שֶׁטֶף, Sl 32:6, al. ;]
a flood, deluge: Mt 24:38-39 Lc 17:27, 2Pe 2:5.†
(AS)

G2628.def:
κατ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jr 17:16 (רָאָה), 1Ma.6:23, al. ;]
to follow after: Lc 23:55; with dative of person(s), At 16:17.†
(AS)

G2629.def:
κατα-κόπτω
[in LXX for נָכָה hi., כָּתַת pi., etc. ;]
to cut up, cut in pieces (cf. Is 27:9, Jr 21:7, 2Cr 34:7): ἑαυτὸν λίθοις, Mc 5:5.†
(AS)

G2630.def:
κατα-κρημνίζω
(κρημνός), [in LXX: 2Cr 25:12 (שָׁלַךְ hi.), 2Ma.12:15 2Mac 14:43, 4Ma.4:25*.]
to throw over a precipice, cast down head­long: Lc 4:29.†
(AS)

G2631.def:
κατά-κριμα, -τος, τό
(κατακρίνω),
penalty (RV, condemnation; but cf. Deiss., BS, 264 f.; MM, Exp., xv): Rm 5:16, 18 8:1.†
(AS)

G2632.def:
κατα-κρίνω
[in LXX: Et 2:1 (גָּזַר ni.), Wis.4:16, Dan LXX TH Sus 1:53, 4:34, TH Sus 1:41,48,53* ;]
to give judgment against, condemn: Rm 8:34; with accusative of person(s), Mc 14:64, Jo 8:10-11; disting. fr. κρίνειν, Rm 2:1, 1Co 11:32; before θανάτῳ (cl. -ου or -ον), Mt 20:18, Mc 10:33; pass., Mt 27:3, Mc 16:16, Rm 14:23, 1Co 11:32, 2Pe 2:6. Metaphorical, of condemning through a good example: Mt 12:41-42, Lc 11:31-32, Rm 8:3, Hb 11:7 †
(AS)

G2634.def:
κατα-κυριεύω
[in LXX: Gn 1:28 (כָּבַשׁ), Sl 110:2 Sir.17:4, al. ;]
to gain or exercise dominion (over);
__(a) absol. (Arist.);
__(b) with genitive (Arist., al.): Mt 20:25, Mc 10:42, At 19:16, 1Pe 5:3.†
SYN.: (κατεξουσιάζω) (see Swete, Mk., l.with) (AS)

G2635.def:
κατα-λαλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָבַר ni., pi. ;]
to speak evil of, rail at: in cl., with accusative; in LXX,
__(a) with genitive,
__(b) before κατά, with genitive; in NT, with genitive (M, Pr., 65): Tg 4:11, 1Pe 2:12; pass., 1Pe 3:16,†
(AS)

G2637.def:
κατά-λαλος, -ου, ὁ
a railer, defamer: Rm 1:30.†
SYN.: (ψιθυριστής), a whisperer (see Tr., Syn., § cvii, 15; Lft., Notes, 256) (AS)

G2638.def:
κατα-λαμβάνω
[in LXX for נָשַׂג hi., לָכַד, etc. ;]
__1. to lap hold of, seize, appropriate: Mc 9:18; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 9:24, Fp 3:12-13
__2. to overtake: as carrel, of διώκω (Field, Notes, 158 f.), Rm 9:30; ἡ ἡμέρα, 1Ts 5:4; of evils, Jo 1:5 12:35 (cf. 617 T); hence, to surprise, discover: Jo 8:3-4],
__3. Of mental action, to apprehend, comprehend; so mid., in NT (M, Pr., 158): Ef 3:18; before ὅτι, At 4:13 10:34; with accusative and inf., At 25:25 (MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)

G2639.def:
κατα-λέγω
[in LXX: Dt 19:16 (עָנָה), 2Ma.7:30 R * ;]
__1. to lay down; mid. (in Hom.), to lie down.
__2. to narrate (LXX, ll. with).
__3. to choose out, hence, to enrol (as of soldiers, Hdt., Thuc., a1., see LS, see word): of widows, pass., 1Tm 5:9 (cf. Ellic.; CGT, in l).†
(AS)

G2641.def:
κατα-λείπω
[in LXX chiefly far שָׁאַר, ni., hi., also for עָזַב, יָתַר, etc. ;]
__1 1, to leave behind, leave: with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), Mt 4:13, Mc 12:19, 21, Lc 20:31, At 24:27 25:14, Hb 11:27; of sailing by a place, At 21:3; ptcp., καταλιπών, redundant (Dalman, Words, 21 f.), Mt 16:4 21:17; pass., Jo 8:9, 1Ts 3:1; metaphorically, εὐθεῖαν ὁδόν, 2Pe 2:15.
__2. to forsake, abandon: Mt 19:5, Mc 10:7" (LXX) Mc 14:52, Lc 5:28 15:4, At 6:2, Ef 5:31" (LXX) .
__3. to leave remaining, reserve: with accusative and inf., Lc 10:40; ἐμαυτῷ, Rm 11:4 (LXX); pass., Hb 4:1 (cf. ἐν-κατα-λείπω).†
(AS)

G2642.def:
κατα-λιθάζω
(= cl. -θόω; cf. -θοβολέω, Êx 17:4, Num_14:10)
to cast stones at, to stone: Lc 20:6.†
(AS)

G2643.def:
κατ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταλλάσσω), [in LXX: Is 9:5(4), 2Ma.5:20 * ;]
__1. exchange.
__2. reconciliation: Rm 5:11; κ. κόσμου, Rm 11:15; διακονία τῆς κ., 2Co 5:18; λόγος τῆς κ., 2Co 5:19.†
(AS)

G2644.def:
κατ-αλλάσσω
(Att.. -ττω; cf. ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX: Jr 48:39 (חָתַת), 2Ma.1:5 2Mac 7:33 2Mac 8:29 * ;]
prop., to change, exchange (esp. of money); hence, of persons, to change from emnity to friendship, to reconcile (for exx. in cl., see Thayer„ LS): of the reconciliation of man to God (Lft., Notes, 288; ICC on Ro, l.with; DCG, ii, 474, 797), 2Co 5:18-19; pass Rm 5:10, 2Co 5:20; of a woman returning to her husband, 1Co 7:11 (cf. ἀπο-καταλλάσσω).†
(AS)

G2645.def:
κατά-λοιπος, -ον
[in LXX for שָׁאַר, שְׁאֵרִית, יָתַר, etc. ;]
left remaining: ἱο κ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, At 15:17 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2646.def:
κατά-λυμα, -τος, τό
(καταλύω), [in LXX: Êx 4:24 (מָלוֹן), 1Rs 9:22 (לִשְׁכָּה), etc. ;]
__1. = cl. καταγώγιον (cf. πανδοχεῖον), an inn, lodgingplace: Lc 2:7 (so Ex, l.with, and MGr.).
__2. a guest-room (1Sam,l.with): Mc 14:14, Lc 22:11.†
(AS)

G2647.def:
κατα-λύω
[in LXX for לוּן, שָׁבַת, etc. ;]
__1. to destroy, cast down: Mt 24:2, Mc 13:2, Lc 21:6; τ. ναόν, Mt 26:61 27:40, Mc 14:58 15:29, At 6:14; οἰκίαν, 2Co 5:1; opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν, Gl 2:18. Metaphorical, to overthrow, annul, abrogate: At 5:38-39; τ. ἔργον τ. θεοῦ, Rm 14:20; τ. νόμον, Mt 5:17 (2Ma.2:22).
__2. to unloose, unyoke (e.g. horses), hence intrans., of travellers (cf. κατάλυμα), to take up one's quarters, lodge (cl., Gn 19:2, al.): Lc 9:12 19:7.†
(AS)

G2648.def:
κατα-μανθάνω
[in LXX: Gn 34:1 (רָאָה), Jó 35:4 (5) (שׁוּר), Sir.9:5, 8, al. ;]
to learn thoroughly, observe well, consider carefully (on distinction bet. κ. and μανθάνω, cf. M, Pr., 117): Mt 6:28.†
(AS)

G2649.def:
κατα-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jó 15:6, Pv 25:18 (עָנָה), al. ;]
to bear witness againt: with accusative of thing(s) and genitive of person(s), Mt 26:62 27:13, Mc 14:60.†
(AS)

G2650.def:
κατα-μένω
[in LXX for יָשַׁב (Nm 20:1, al.), etc. ;]
to remain permanently, abide: At 1:13, 1Co 16:6, WH (παραμ-, T, EV).†
(AS)

G2654.def:
κατ-αν-αλίσκω
[in LXX chiefly forאָכַל ;]
__1. to use up, spend.
__2. to consume: of fire, ptcp., Hb 12:29 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2655.def:
κατα-ναρκάω, -ῶ
(ναρκάω, to grow numb, in LXX, in causal sense, for יָקַע, Gn 32:25 (26); without Heb. equiv., Gn 32:32 (33) Jó 33:19, Dan LXX 11:6*);
__1. to cause to grow numb.
__2. Intrans., to grow numb; hence metaphorically, to be inactive, be burdensome to with genitive, 2Co 11:9 12:13-14; pass., to be quite numb (Hippocr.).†
(AS)

G2656.def:
κατα-νεύω
__1. to nod assent,
__2. to make a sign by nodding the head: with dative of person(s), Lc 5:7.†
(AS)

G2657.def:
κατα-νοέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., רָאָה, etc. ;]
to take note of, perceive, consider carefully: At 7:31-32; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 7:3, Lc 6:41 12:24, 27 20:23, At 11:6 27:39, Rm 4:19; with accusative of person(s), Hb 3:1 10:24, Tg 1:23-24 (on the distinction bet. κ. and νοέω simplex, see M, Pr., 117).†
(AS)

G2658.def:
κατ-αντάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Rs 3:29 (חוּל), 2Ma.4:21 2Mac 4:24 2Mac 4:44 2Mac 6:14 * ;]
to come to, arrive at: before εἰς, with accusative loc., At 16:1 18:19, 24 21:7 25:13 (see M, Pr., 132) At 27:12 28:13; before ἀντικρύ, with genitive, At 20:15. Metaphorical, before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), 1Co 10:11 14:36; id. with accusative of thing(s), to attain to: At 26:7, Ef 4:13, Fp 3:11.†
(AS)

G2659.def:
κατά-νυξις, -εως, ἡ
(κατανύσσω, which see), [in LXX: Sl 60:3 (תַּרְעֵלָה), Is 29:10 (תַּרְדֵּמָה)* ;]
__1. a pricking.
__2. (Perhaps through resembl. of κατανύσσω to -νυστάζω), torpor of mind, stupefaction: Rm 11:8 (LXX) (see ICC, in l; Field, Notes, 157).†
(AS)

G2660.def:
κατα-νύσσω
[in LXX: Gn 34:7 (עָצַב hith.), Lv 10:3, Sl 4:4, Psa 29:12, al. (דָּמַם), Dan LXX TH Sus 1:10 (רָדַם ni.), Sir.12:12 14:1, al. ;]
__1. to strike or prick violently.
__2. to stun.
__3. Of strong emotion, pass., to be smitten: τὴν καρδίαν, At 2:37 (see: κατάνυξις).†
(AS)

G2661.def:
κατ-αξιόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.13:12, 3Ma.3:21 3Mac 4:11, 4Ma.18:3 * ;]
to deem worthy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), 2Ts 1:5; pass. before inf., Lc 20:35, At 5:41.†
(AS)

G2662.def:
κατα-πατέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for דָּרַךְ, רָמַס, שָׁאַף, etc. ;]
to tread down, trample under foot: Mt 7:6, Lc 12:1; pass., Mt 5:13, Lc 8:5. Metaphorical, τ. υἱὸν τ. θεοῦ, Hb 10:29.†
(AS)

G2663.def:
κατά-παυσις, -εως, ἡ
(καταπαύω), [in LXX chiefly for מְנוּחָה, Sl 95:11, Is 66:1, al.; ἡμέρα τῆς κ., 2Ma.15:1]
__1. in cl., a putting to rest, causing to cease.
__2. In LXX and NT, rest, repose: At 7:49 (LXX), Hb 3:11, 18 4:1, 3 4:5, 10-11†
(AS)

G2664.def:
κατα-παύω
[in LXX for נוּחַ, שָׁבַת, etc. ;]
__1. trans.,
__(a) to cause to cease, restrain: At 14:18;
__(b) to cause to rest: Hb 4:8.
__2. Intrans., to rest: before ἀτό, Hb 4:4 (LXX), Hb 4:10.†
(AS)

G2665.def:
κατα-πέτασμα, -τος, τό
(= cl. παραπέτασμα) [in LXX chiefly for פֹּרֶכֶת (the veil of the Holy of Holies), Êx 26:31, Lv 21:23, al.; also for מָסָךְ (the outer veil), Êx 35:12, Num_3:26, al. (elsewhere κάλυμμα) ;]
in NT always the inner veil or curtain of the Temple (or Tabernacle): Mt 27:51, Mc 15:38, Lc 23:45, Hb 6:19 9:3; figuratively, ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ Hb 10:20.†
(AS)

G2666.def:
κατα-πίνω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּלַע ;]
__1. to drink down, swallow: Mt 23:24, Ap 12:16.
__2. to devour: 1Pe 5:8. Metaphorical, to swallow up, consume: pass., 1Co 15:54 (LXX), 2Co 2:7 5:4, Hb 11:29.†
(AS)

G2667.def:
κατα-πίπτω
[in LXX: Sl 145:14 (נָפַל), etc. ;]
to fall down: At 28:6; before εἰς, At 26:14; ἐπί with accusative, Lc 8:6.†
(AS)

G2668.def:
κατα-πλέω, -ῶ
to sail down, sail to land, put in: εἰς τ. χώραν, Lc 8:26.†
(AS)

G2669.def:
κατα-πονέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:2 (A), 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 2:13 * ;]
to wear down, oppress, treat hardly: pass., At 7:24, 2Pe 2:7.†
(AS)

G2670.def:
κατα-πονίζω
[in LXX for טָבַע pu., Êx 15:4 A, בָּלַע pi., שָׁטַף, Sl 55:9 69:2, al. ;]
to throw into the sea, sink or drown therein: Mt 14:30; pass., Mt 18:6.†
(AS)

G2671.def:
κατ-άρα, -ας, -ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for קְלָלָה ;]
a curse: Gl 3:10, 13 Hb 6:8, 2Pe 2:14; opposite to εὐλογία, Tg 3:10; concrete, of Christ, Gl 3:13 (see Lft. in l).†
(AS)

G2672.def:
κατ-αράομαι, -ώμαι depon.
(κατάρα), [in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi. ;]
to curse: with accusative, Mc 11:21; opposite to εὐλογέω, Lc 6:26, Rm 12:14, Tg 3:9; pass. pf. ptcp., accursed, under a curse (see M, Pr., 221): Mt 25:41.†
(AS)

G2673.def:
κατ-αργέω, -ῶ
(κατά, causative, ἀργός = ἀ-εργός), [in LXX: 2Es.4.21; 2Es.4.23; 2Es.5.5; 2Es.6.8 (בְּטֵל)* ;]
to make idle or inactive (χέρας, Eur., Phœn., 753): of soil occupied by an unfruitful tree, Lc 13:7. Metaphorical (Inscr.), to render inoperative or invalid, to abrogate, abolish: Rm 3:3, 31, 1Co 1:28 6:13 13:11 15:24, Gl 3:17, Ef 2:15, 2Ts 2:8, 2Tm 1:10, Hb 2:14; pass., Rm 4:14 6:6, 1Co 2:6 13:8 13:10 15:26, 2Co 3:7 3:11-14 Gl 5:11; before ἀπό (of persons), to be separated, discharged or loosed from, Rm 7:2, 6, Gl 5:4.†
(AS)

G2674.def:
κατ-αριθμέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Cr 31:19 (יָחַשׂ hith.), al. ;]
to number or count among: before ἐν, At 1:1.†
(AS)

G2675.def:
κατ-αρτίζω
[in LXX chiefly in Ps (Sl 8:2 al.; כּוּן, etc.) and Ezra (כְּלַל) ;]
to render ἄρτιος, i.e. fit, complete;
__(a) to mend, repair: Mt 4:21, Mc 1:19;
__(b) to furnish completely, complete, equip, prepare: pass., Lc 6:40, Rm 9:22, Hb 11:3; mid., Mt 21:16 (LXX), Hb 10:5 (LXX);
__(with) in ethical sense, to prepare, complete, perfect: Gl 6:1 (EV, restore), 1Pe 5:10; pass., 1Co 1:10 (Field, Notes, 167), 2Co 13:11, Hb 13:21 (cf. προ-καταρτίζω).†
(AS)

G2676.def:
κατ-άρτισις, -εως, ἡ
(καταρτίζω),
a strengthening, making fit: in ethical sense, 2Co 13:9.†
(AS)

G2677.def:
καταρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in Sm.: Is 38:12 * ;]
= κατάρτισις (but see ICC, Eph. l.with): Ef 4:12.†
(AS)

G2678.def:
κατα-σείω
[in LXX: Da TH Bel 1:14 AR, 1Ma.6:38 * ;]
__1. to shake down.
__2. Of the hand, to shake or wave as a signal: τ. χεῖρα, At 19:33; τ. χειρί, At 13:16; id. with dative of person(s), At 21:40; before inf., At 12:17.†
(AS)

G2679.def:
κατα-σκάπτω
[in LXX for נָתַץ, הָרַס, etc. ;]
to dig down: Rm 11:3 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2680.def:
κατα-σκευάζω
[in LXX: Is 40:19, 28, (בָּרָא), etc. ;]
to prepare, make ready: τ. ὁδόν, Mt 11:10, Mc 1:2, Lc 7:27; οἶκον, Hb 3:3-4; σκηνήν, Hb 9:2, 6; κιβωτόν, Hb 11:7, 1Pe 3:20; pass. pf. ptcp., λαον κ., Lc 1:17.†
(AS)

G2681.def:
κατα-σκηνόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for סָכַךְ ;]
to pitch one's tent, lodge, dwell: before ἐν, Mt 13:32, Lc 13:19; ὑπό, with accusative, Mc 4:32; ἐπ᾽ ἐλπιδι, At 2:26 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2682.def:
κατα-σκήνωσις, εως, ἡ
[in LXX: 1Cr 28:2 (בָּנָה), Eze.37:27 (מִשְׁכָּן) Tob.1:4, Wis.9:8, 2Ma.14:35 (R)* ;]
__1. prop., an encamping, taking up one's quarters (Polyb., al., see LS; and cf. LXX, ll. with).
__2. a lodging, abode: of birds, Mt 8:20, Lc 9:58.†
(AS)

G2684.def:
κατα-σκοπέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 4Ki.10:3, 1Cr 19:3 (רָגַל pi.), 1Ma.5:38 (A)* ;]
to view closely, inspect, spy out: with accusative, Gl 2:4.†
(AS)

G2685.def:
κατά-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for רָגַל pi. ;]
a spy: Hb 11:31.†
(AS)

G2686.def:
κατα-σοφίζομαι
[in LXX: Êx 1:10 (חָכָם hith.), Jdth.5:11 10:19 * ;]
to deal craftily with, outwit: At 7:19 (LXX) †
(AS)

G2687.def:
κατα-στέλλω
[in LXX: 2Ma.4:31, 3Ma.6:1 * ;]
__1. to let down, lower.
__2. to keep down, restrain: with accusative, At 19:35-36 †
(AS)

G2688.def:
κατά-στημα, -τος, τό
(καθίστημι), in LXX: 3Ma.5:45 (-εμα, A) * ;]
__1. condition, of health, etc.
__2. demeanour: Tt 2:3 (for exx. see Field, Notes, 220).†
(AS)

G2689.def:
κατα-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταστέλλω), [in LXX: Is 61:3 (מַעֲטֶה)* ;]
__1. a letting down, checking.
__2. steadiness, quietness in demeanour.
__3. LXX and NT (cf. Plut., ii, 65 D; -ίζω = vestire), a garment, dress, attire: 1Tm 2:9 (but see Ellic., in l).†
(AS)

G2690.def:
κατα-στρέφω
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, etc., Gn 19:21, Jr 20:16, al. ;]
__1. to turn down, turn over; as, the soil.
__2. to overturn, overthrow: Mt 21:12, Mc 11:15; pass. pf. ptcp., At 15:16 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2692.def:
κατα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταστρέφω), [in LXX: Jó 21:17, Pv 1:27 (אֵיד), al. ;]
__1. overthrow: 2Pe 2:6 (WH, om.).
__2. Metaphorical, subversion, upsetting (cf. καθαίρεσις, 2Co 13:10): 2Tm 2:14.†
(AS)

G2693.def:
κατα-στρώννυμι
[in LXX: Nm 14:16 (שָׁחַט), Jó 12:23 (שָׁטַח), שָׁטַח), Jdt.4.1-15; Jdt.2.1-28 Mac.4 ;]
__1. to strew or spread over.
__2. to lay low, overthrow: 1Co 10:5.†
(AS)

G2694.def:
κατα-σύρω
[in LXX: Jr 49:10 (חָשַׂף), Dan LXX, Dn 11:10, 26 (שָׁטַף) * ;]
__1. to pull down.
__2. to drag away: with accusative of person(s), Lc 12:58.†
(AS)

G2695.def:
κατα-σφάζω
[in LXX: Zc 11:5 (הָרַג), Eze.16:40 (בָּתַק pi.), 2Ma.8:1-36 ;]
to kill off, slay: with accusative, Lc 19:27.†
(AS)

G2696.def:
κατα-σφραγίζω
[in LXX: Jó 9:7 37:7 (חָתַם), Wis.2:5 * ;]
to seal up, secure with a seal: Ap 5:1.†
(AS)

G2697.def:
κατά-σχεσις, -εως, ἡ
(κατέχω), [in LXX nearly always for אֲחֻזָּה ]
__1. a holding back.
__2. LXX and NT, a holding fast, possession: At 7:5, 45.†
(AS)

G2698.def:
κατα-τίθημι
[in LXX: 1Cr 21:27 שׁוּב hi.), Sl 41:8 (יָצַק), 1Ma.10:23, al. ;]
to lay down, deposit, lay by: Mc 15:46, T; mid., to lay up for oneself: χάριν (Hdt., al., see LS, see word), with dative of person(s), At 24:27 25:9.†
(AS)

G2699.def:
κατα-τομή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in Sm.: Jr 31:37 (κατατέμνω is used in LXX of forbidden mutilations: Lv 21:5, al.) ;]
__1. incision.
__2. excision, concision, mutilation: in sarcasm, by paronomasia, in contrast to (true) περιτομή (v3), of Judaizing Christians, Fp 3:2 (see Lft., in l; Cremer, 883).†
(AS)
